title: Audit export: add pipeline dashboards + alert rules (latency, error rate, backlog/DLQ)
author: Allison Grant
description:
Adds initial Grafana dashboards + Prometheus alerting for the SIEM-ready audit export (beta) pipeline. Goal: make backlog growth, delivery latency, connector errors, and DLQ behavior visible/operable for Hosted + Dedicated, with sane defaults and clear tuning guidance for Private deployments.

What’s included: (1) Dashboard: “Audit Export / Overview” with per-destination panels (Splunk HEC, Datadog Logs, S3) for throughput, success/error rate, p50/p95/p99 end-to-end delivery latency, retry rate, and last_success_at/last_error_at signals. (2) Dashboard: “Audit Export / Queues & DLQ” with backlog depth, age of oldest message, consumer lag, retry/backoff counts, and DLQ volume + top error classes. (3) Alert rules + runbook links: backlog growth / oldest age, sustained elevated error rate, destination stalled (no successes), and DLQ non-empty. (4) “Tuning guidance” doc section: recommended thresholds for beta, how to set per-environment overrides, and how to avoid paging storms during planned sink maintenance.

Metrics assumptions (implemented in exporter/control-plane codepaths already, this PR is wiring only): audit_export_events_total{destination_type,outcome}, audit_export_delivery_latency_seconds{destination_type}, audit_export_backlog_depth{destination_id}, audit_export_oldest_event_age_seconds{destination_id}, audit_export_dlq_events_total{destination_type,error_class}, audit_export_connector_requests_total{destination_type,status_class}, plus service-level request/error metrics for the audit-export control-plane.

Alerting philosophy: page on symptoms that impact customer-visible delivery (stalled delivery, runaway backlog/age, sustained error rate), ticket on early warning signals (transient throttling, elevated retries) to keep beta noise manageable.

Follow-ups (not in this PR): add per-tenant/region breakdown once labels are standardized in audit-exporter; add a dedicated panel for HEC ACK latency when ACK is enabled; add a canned “replay window” dashboard link once replay tooling ships.

Refs: ENG-13931 (dashboards/alerts), ENG-13923 (queue/worker), ENG-13928 (status endpoints).
commits: alerts: add audit-export alert rules w/ runbook links
docs: add alert tuning guidance for Hosted vs Private
chore: recording rules for common audit-export rates/latency quantiles
conversation:
Sean Gallagher (review): Panels look good. Two asks before approval: (1) make the backlog alert key off oldest_event_age rather than depth alone; depth varies a lot by tenant. (2) add a non-paging alert for elevated retries that we can route to #eng-sre during beta so we can see throttling patterns.

Allison Grant (author): Updated. Backlog paging alert is now based on oldest_event_age_seconds > 900 for 15m (with a separate warning at 300s). Added a ticket-level alert (severity=warning) for retry_rate > 5% for 30m, routed to slack only.

Rafael Mendes (review): Please add explicit notes in the doc about planned sink maintenance (e.g., Splunk HEC token rotation / endpoint changes). We’ve already seen connector retry storms in staging; we should recommend pausing destinations if customers are doing changes.

Allison Grant (author): Added to tuning guidance + included a small “mute vs pause” section. Also linked the audit-export backlog drain/replay runbook from the alert annotations.

Aisha Bello (review): Nit: dashboard variables currently include destination_id; that’ll explode cardinality in some views. Can we default to destination_type and only expose destination_id in the detail dashboard?

Allison Grant (author): Adjusted default variable to destination_type, and moved destination_id panels behind a collapsed row with a warning about cardinality. Also updated recording rules to prefer destination_type aggregations.

Ethan Park (review): For Private deployments we may not have the same queue metrics depending on backing store; please avoid hard dependencies in the dashboard. Can you guard those panels or show ‘no data’ gracefully?

Allison Grant (author): Converted queue panels to be resilient: they show ‘No data’ with a note if queue metrics are absent; docs call out which panels require the default queue implementation. Added a small “Private install checklist” callout for metrics wiring.

Final review: Sean + Rafael approved after rerender + promtool checks passed. Squash-merged.
release_notes: Internal: Adds operability dashboards + alerting for SIEM-ready audit export (beta). Includes alert tuning guidance and runbook links. No customer-facing behavior changes.
